points.name: sports.waiting.start_register
points.interpretation: The waiting view registers C5CD790 with event filter 4; its callback passes the sport record to C5CD4DC, which checks storage and selects a training/start flow.

points.name: sports.waiting.start_data
points.interpretation: C5CD790 reads a sport record pointer and passes it to the waiting-view click handler.

points.name: sports.waiting.settings_register
points.interpretation: The waiting view registers C5CCE38, which navigates to the sport settings page.

points.name: sports.waiting.settings_data
points.interpretation: The callback reads the sport record and uses its first word as sport type when opening settings.

points.name: sports.waiting.warmup_register
points.interpretation: The waiting view registers C5CCFA0 when the warmup branch is enabled.

points.name: sports.waiting.warmup_data
points.interpretation: The warmup callback reads a sport record pointer and uses a nested pointer before navigating.

points.name: sports.waiting.swim_register
points.interpretation: The swim sport branch registers C5CCE78, which opens the radio-select page for pool length.

points.name: sports.waiting.swim_data
points.interpretation: The swim-length callback reads a sport record pointer and dereferences its nested data.

points.name: sports.waiting.runway_register
points.interpretation: The sport type 208 branch registers C5CCE28 to navigate to sport page 4.

points.name: sports.waiting.course_info_register
points.interpretation: Certain course variants register C5CC928 on their info icon.

points.name: sports.waiting.sport_text
points.interpretation: The non-course branch resolves and sets a localized sport name.

points.name: sports.waiting.course_text
points.interpretation: The course branch resolves and sets a course name.

evidence: The sports manifest registers the three selected descriptors. Waiting and realtime create call C58AB40, which stores its return at descriptor +60; both destroy paths call C58AB80 with the descriptor, freeing and clearing the same slot. The voice page stores a root and clears it on destroy before cleaning other state. The waiting builder registers distinct handlers for the start, settings, warmup, pool-length and runway branches.
scope: Only the recorded registration, event-data and UI calls. Training execution, other navigation paths, timer callbacks, sport measurements and voice media internals are not intercepted.
limitations: The event data points return pointers to live sport records, sometimes with nested pointers; replacing them incorrectly can crash or corrupt state. Suppressing start can prevent storage checks and training; skipping destruction can strand timers, media and sensors. Guards are not thread barriers and the voice volume callback is asynchronous. Device behavior and recovery remain unverified.
